I created `docs/policies/internal-http.md`. It says the project's current decision is HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception, including for internal hosts. The stated reason is that certificate management is already in place.

The memory has two conflicting statements on this. The earlier one allowed plain HTTP for internal hosts because they sit behind the firewall. A later one requires HTTPS everywhere and explicitly replaces the earlier one. I used the later one and left the retired position out of the file.

Neither statement is in the decision catalog. Both appear only as recorded session excerpts, so the file rests on the newest excerpt rather than a catalogued decision.

Separately, the Muninn heartbeat reported that 20 hook runs started and never finished, so a hook may be exceeding its timeout.
